title: Tiny, hard to get ice out.
text: Tiny, hard to get ice out.. When I read this was small ice cube tray, I was expecting the ice cube holes to be small, but the entire thing is small. It will probably take all 3 to fill up my glass. I froze one to try it out,and it took forever to get the ice out of those tiny holes. My hands were freezing when I finished. I'm going to return

product_metadata.title: Hocerlu Ice Cube Trays, 3 Pack Silicone Small Ice Cube Trays with Removable Lid, Easy-Release & Flexible Hexagonal 37-Ice Cube Molds, Stackable for Freezer, Chilled Drinks, Whiskey, Cocktail - Black
features: [FOOD GRADE SAFETY MATERIAL] Reusable Ice cube trays are made of premium silicone material with food-grade safety. It can be used in the freezer, microwave and dishwasher.

[EASY RELEASE & DISHWASHER SAFE] Silicone is uniquely soft and elastic, with a few twists, the ice cubes can be released from the mold effortlessly. Or simply push its bottom up to release ice cubes easily. These silicone ice cube trays are safe from -4°F to 400°F, so they are safe to use with any dishwasher.

[UPGRADED LID DESIGN] The upgraded lid is more airtight, preventing spills and the freezing of excess water and keeping ice cubes from absorbing freezer odors. In addition, the design with a cover can be stacked in multiple layers, saving space without sticking.

[COMPACT & FUN CUBE SHAPE] The unique honeycomb shape is more eye-catching and adds flavor to your DIY drinks or food! Small and fun, the cubes are just the right size to fit both a wide-necked glass and a small-necked drink bottle. Each ice cube mold contains 37 ice cubes, for a total of 111.

[WIDE APPLICATION] The stackable silicone ice cube tray kits are great for home, parties, bars, gifts, etc. You can use them to cool your drinks and make homemade delicacies, such as whiskey, cocktails, coffee, infusing fruit or herbs.
